ideas.pitch: A deterministic resource governor and local sensor-fusion safety node running on the Arduino UNO Q for small autonomous vessels.
ideas.title: Vessel-Edge: Deterministic Resource Governor for Autonomous Marine Craft
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly showcases the mandatory Arduino UNO Q board running a deterministic control system, matching a proven winning pattern from maritime dual-use hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent nebulizer adherence and dosage verification tracking node built on the Arduino UNO Q with local sensor analytics.
ideas.title: Smart-Nebulizer Edge: IoT Respiratory Therapy Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the HealthTech track with a tangible hardware-focused medical compliance device, mirroring past health hackathon grand prize winners.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed physical safety monitor using the Arduino UNO Q and local sensors to immediately halt machinery when PPE violations occur.
ideas.title: Industrial-Safe-Net: Edge AI Safety Violation Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the Industry 2.0 track by solving an urgent factory floor safety problem with a working hardware prototype.

ideas.pitch: An embedded power management system running on the Arduino UNO Q that computes real-time renewable energy mix ratios and sustainability scores.
ideas.title: Eco-Grid Micro-Monitor: Renewable Energy Mix Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the Utopia track by delivering clear, quantifiable environmental impact metrics straight from a microcontroller.

ideas.pitch: An automated sorting bin that classifies waste items using proximity sensors and local classifiers hosted on the Arduino UNO Q.
ideas.title: Bin-Intel: Physical AI-Powered Waste Segregation Node
ideas.track: Odyssey – A Journey to Limitless Possibilities
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical hardware automation with the Odyssey track's focus on emerging tech, providing a crowd-pleasing live demo.
